name: Recursive Inheritance Firewall Registry
purpose: Prevent unresolved recursive assumptions, symbolic scaffolds, and deceptive stability classifications from propagating into theorem-facing or simulation-facing infrastructure.

firewall_rules.name: Symbolic Artifact Block
firewall_rules.requirement: No RC-SYMBOLIC artifact may support theorem-facing derivation.

firewall_rules.name: Partial Artifact Block
firewall_rules.requirement: No RC-PARTIAL artifact may propagate without complete registry, documentation, validator, and result stack.

firewall_rules.name: Blocked Artifact Isolation
firewall_rules.requirement: RC-BLOCKED and persistent failure structures must remain attached to failure_geometry_registry and excluded from proof support.

firewall_rules.name: Deceptive Stability Block
firewall_rules.requirement: Deceptive grooves, false stability traps, and deceptive hysteresis classes may not enter proof eligibility.

firewall_rules.name: Simulation Evidence Limit
firewall_rules.requirement: Simulation evidence may support restricted-local review only and may not promote theorem status.

firewall_rules.name: LAW034 Global Closure Block
firewall_rules.requirement: No local composition result may be interpreted as global compositional closure.

inheritance_classes.meaning: Artifact may propagate into restricted-local review infrastructure.
Artifact may propagate only with explicit constraints and review-required status.
Artifact cannot propagate into theorem-facing infrastructure.
Artifact retained only for historical or failure analysis.
